description: This source file manages UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) configurations in a system, providing functions for initialization, handling sections, options, import/export, commit/revert, setting values, and walking through configuration sections. It includes code for managing configurations via context switching, section filtering, and string operations, used specifically in the context of a system's configuration management.

methods.name: void bbfdm_uci_init_ctx(struct uci_context ** uci_ctx,const char * confdir,const char * savedir)
methods.description: Initializes a uci_context with specified configuration and saved directories.

methods.name: void dm_uci_init(struct dmctx * bbf_ctx)
methods.description: Initializes multiple uci contexts based on the dm_type in the bbctxt structure and assigns global uci contexts.

methods.name: void dm_uci_exit(struct dmctx * bbf_ctx)
methods.description: Frees and cleans up the uci contexts within the given bbctxt, resetting global context variables.

methods.name: char * dmuci_list_to_string(struct uci_list * list,const char * delimitor)
methods.description: Concatenates list elements into a single string with a specified delimiter.

methods.name: int dmuci_lookup_ptr(struct uci_context * ctx,struct uci_ptr * ptr,const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Performs a lookup for a UCI configuration item with specified package, section, option, and value.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_section_type(const char * package,const char * section,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the section type of a specified package and section.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_option_value_string(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the string value of a specific option within a section of a package.

methods.name: char * dmuci_get_option_value_fallback_def(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * default_value)
methods.description: Gets the value of an option or returns a default if the option is empty or not found.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_option_value_list(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,struct uci_list ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of values associated with a specified option.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_value_by_section_string(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the string value of an option within a specific section structure.

methods.name: char * dmuci_get_value_by_section_fallback_def(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,const char * default_value)
methods.description: Gets the value of an option in a section, falling back to a default if needed.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_value_by_section_list(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,struct uci_list ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves list values of an option in a section.

methods.name: int dmuci_set_value_by_section(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets the value of an option within a section.

methods.name: int dmuci_delete_by_section(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Deletes a specific option in a section.

methods.name: int dmuci_delete_by_section_unnamed(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Deletes an option in a section without referring to the section name explicitly.

methods.name: int dmuci_add_list_value_by_section(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Adds a value to a list option in a section.

methods.name: int dmuci_del_list_value_by_section(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Removes a value from a list option in a section.

methods.name: int dmuci_rename_section_by_section(struct uci_section * s,const char * value)
methods.description: Renames a section identified by its pointer.

methods.name: int dmuci_reoder_section_by_section(struct uci_section * s,char * pos)
methods.description: Reorders a section within the configuration.

methods.name: struct:uci_section * dmuci_walk_section(const char * package,const char * stype,const void * arg1,const void * arg2,int cmp,int (* filter)(struct uci_section * s,const void * value),struct uci_section * prev_section,int walk)
methods.description: Iterates over sections matching specific criteria, with filtering options.

methods.name: struct:uci_section * dmuci_walk_all_sections(const char * package,struct uci_section * prev_section,int walk)
methods.description: Returns the next section in a list of all sections.

methods.name: int db_get_value_string(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a database configuration.

methods.name: bool dmuci_string_to_boolean(const char * value)
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean value based on common true indicators.

methods.name: bool dmuci_is_option_value_empty(struct uci_section * s,const char * option_name)
methods.description: Checks if a given option value within a section is empty.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_section_name(const char * sec_name,char ** value)
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal section name into a string if it’s hex encoded, otherwise copies the name.

methods.name: int dmuci_set_section_name(const char * sec_name,char * str,size_t size)
